svg.text: PVST+ runs one spanning tree per VLAN. Older switches can't run as many as you have VLANs.
Each square is one VLAN trunked to this switch: 160 VLANs, but the platform supports 128 instances.
Platform limit of 128 STP instances exceeded. No instance created for VLAN190
VLANs above the limit run without their own spanning tree: a loop in those VLANs is not blocked.
